description:

title: Analista Planner Sênior
description:
Essa cadeira tem foco em planejamento comercial orientado por dados e gestão estratégica de vendas . Você atuará garantindo que as decisões de negócio sejam baseadas em análises consistentes, com o objetivo de maximizar resultados e eficiência das campanhas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar o forecast de vendas (OTB), incluindo projeções mensais, semanais e rolling forecast, assegurando acuracidade e alinhamento com os objetivos comerciais;
  • Elaborar o planejamento orçamentário (budget), com desdobramentos por marca, tipo de campanha e tipologias de produto, garantindo consistência estratégica e financeira;
  • Monitorar a performance de vendas de forma contínua, com acompanhamento em tempo real (hora a hora) e foco em campanhas críticas, identificando desvios e oportunidades de ajuste;
  • Propor ações estratégicas com base em dados, incluindo trocas de sortimento, reforço de mix, inclusões e descontinuações, visando otimização de resultados;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico dos Business Managers (BMs), contribuindo para a definição e direcionamento de campanhas, incluindo estratégia comercial, pirâmide de preços, composição de mix e profundidade de estoque;
  • Avaliar criticamente planos de campanha, questionando premissas, elevando o nível de detalhamento estratégico e assegurando consistência das iniciativas propostas;
  • Apoiar negociações comerciais por meio de análises e insights baseados em dados, fortalecendo a tomada de decisão;
  • Realizar análises de grade de produtos e diferenciais competitivos das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e alavancas de performance.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação Superior Completa;
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas, modelagem);
  • Ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares);
  • SQL para extração e manipulação de dados (diferencial forte);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de planejamento comercial/ERP.


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (C#/.NET)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js, Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.


You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.


Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations use their technology today, and they process over $5 Billion of payments annually.


Responsibilities:


  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience


  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience (Vue.js, React.js, or Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have \"ownership mindset\" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner, as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)


  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information


  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

QUEM SOMOS


A Sanches é um hub estratégico especializado na construção, evolução e operação de produtos digitais em contextos complexos de negócio. Atuamos estruturando processos, organizando dados e desenvolvendo soluções que apoiam decisões estratégicas e crescimento sustentável das operações.

title: Engineering Design Specialist
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn more, visit: millionlogics.com.


Role Overview

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.


Offer Details :

  • Contract Duration : 12 months
  • Pay : US $200 (take-home) per task
  • Experience : 3+ years
  • Positions : 98
  • Work Mode : Remote


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  •  Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks

  • You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the following; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.
  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualification:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Nice to Have

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round.


How to Apply: Please send us your updated CV to with Job ID- 72123 as your email subject.

title: Banco de Talentos Operador de Manipulação I - 2ºT
description:
Venha fazer parte do Universo Blanver!


Conheça a Blanver:


A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 41 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. A experiência e atuação no desenvolvimento, fabricação e comercialização de medicamentos e insumos farmacêuticos ativos (IFAs) tornou a Blanver especialista nos segmentos de HIV, Hepatite e Osteoporose, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade, atendendo pacientes no Brasil por meio de parcerias com o Ministério da Saúde e laboratórios oficiais. Além disso, também estamos presentes nos segmentos de Oncologia, Doenças Raras e Hematologia, por meio de parcerias estratégias com grandes parceiros internacionais.


As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.


Essas serão algumas das atividades do dia-a-dia como Operador de Produção (Manipulação) I:


• Verificar as condições dos equipamentos (meios), ferramentas, acessórios para realização das suas atividades, avaliando as condições, verificando a manutenção de primeiro nível através de checklist (documentação), para evitar defeitos e manter os equipamentos em boas condições.

• Operar, realizar ajustes e setup completo em equipamentos das etapas de manipulação em tempo padrão e qualidade pré-determinados.

• Realizar a limpeza da área conforme Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP's) e de acordo com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF).

• Seguir fielmente as instruções de trabalho e realizar todos os registros solicitados no documento a fim de que o processo seja realizado de forma padronizada.

• Seguir os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP's) da empresa, realizando as atividades definidas de acordo com as normas e padrões da Blanver, visando a qualidade do produto.

• Respeitar as normas de segurança do trabalho e utilizar os Equipamentos de Proteção Individuais (EPI's), visando reduzir riscos à segurança e garantir a integridade física.

• Conhecer e cumprir os procedimentos internos e o código de conduta ética da empresa, bem como comunicar, qualquer irregularidade que possa ocasionar acidente do trabalho, dano ao meio ambiente ou à saúde.

• Manter o cumprimento dos procedimentos e instruções de trabalho da área, definidas pelo sistema de gestão da qualidade e ambiental, em atendimento as respectivas políticas.

• Se for necessário acesso ao sistema de comunicação interno como email e team interno, pasta na rede, sistema operacionais como Se Suíte, Astrein, Oransys, Datasul ERP, mediante autorização do superior imediato.

• Executar tarefas administrativas como elaboração de documentos produtivos, preenchimento de planilhas eletrônicas de acordo com as atribuições próprias e da natureza do seu trabalho, conforme orientação do superior imediato.

• Compromisso com o código de conduta, ética e integridade: agir com honestidade, transparência, responsabilidade e respeito, seguindo os princípios éticos da empresa e mantendo a confidencialidade das informações.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Seguir completamente as BPFs;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de colaboração.
  • Capacidade de operar e ajustar máquinas e equipamentos de produção farmacêutica, garantindo que funcionem de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos e que a produção ocorra sem interrupções.

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

title: LLM Scientist
description:
We are looking for an \"LLM Scientist \" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Key Responsibilities

Design and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.

title: Consultor Comercial & Onboarding
description:

Remoto · PJ · Fixo + Comissão

A PARKIA é uma plataforma SaaS que automatiza a operação de estacionamentos 24/7 - sem atendente, sem papel, sem fricção.


O produto já funciona. Temos agente de IA no WhatsApp, painel do operador, totem de autoatendimento e pagamento integrado. Tudo numa base única, em tempo real.


Agora precisamos de alguém pra apresentar isso ao mercado.

Você cuida do ciclo completo: do primeiro contato à unidade operando.


- Prospectar estacionamentos pequenos e médios (50–200 vagas)

- Conduzir reuniões e demos do produto

- Negociar e fechar contratos

Não é só conversão. É garantir toda a experiência do cliente.

Perfil:

  • Didático — consegue explicar tecnologia pra quem não é tech

A comissão é dividida intencionalmente.

Somos dois founders técnicos, uma equipe pequena e um produto que já resolve um problema real.


Você vai falar direto com quem decide. Seu feedback vai virar feature. Seu cliente vai virar case.


É remoto e é PJ. E tem muito espaço pra crescer junto.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.


A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.


Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.


Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.


Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.


Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.


Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas \"de marketing\" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.


Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.


Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem


Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

title: Analista de Planejamento de Orçamento de Pessoal Sênior
description:
PROPÓSITO DO CARGO

Garantir a acuracidade e a eficiência do planejamento orçamentário da força de trabalho, fornecendo análises e projeções que subsidiem as decisões estratégicas sobre custo de pessoal, headcount e alocação de recursos humanos.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Coordenar e executar o processo de planejamento orçamentário anual e revisões periódicas (budget e forecast) de pessoal em parceria com Finanças e áreas de negócio.
  • Elaborar projeções de custo de pessoal: salários, encargos sociais, benefícios, horas extras, provisões de férias e 13º salário, desligamentos e contratações.
  • Analisar variações entre orçado e realizado (budget vs. actual), identificando causas-raiz e propondo planos de ação às lideranças.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico de headcount (FTE — Full-Time Equivalent), mapeando necessidades de contratação, substituição e reestruturação por área.
  • Construir e manter modelos financeiros e planilhas dinâmicas de simulação de cenários de custo de pessoal.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais mensais de acompanhamento de despesas com pessoal para lideranças e stakeholders financeiros.
  • Interagir com gestores de negócio para coletar premissas orçamentárias, validar movimentações de pessoal e garantir alinhamento com o orçamento aprovado.
  • Participar ativamente de projetos de melhoria de processos na área de orçamento de pessoal, propondo automações e ganhos de eficiência.
  • Assegurar conformidade das projeções com políticas internas, legislação trabalhista e acordos coletivos vigentes.
  • Desenvolver analistas plenos da equipe, compartilhando boas práticas e orientando a execução das entregas.


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia de Produção, Atuária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas será considerado diferencial.


CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS REQUERIDOS

Finanças e Controladoria aplicadas a Pessoal

  • Sólido conhecimento em planejamento e controle orçamentário (Budget, Forecast e Rolling Forecast).
  • Domínio em análise de variância orçamentária (Budget vs. Actual vs. Prior Year).
  • Conhecimento profundo de encargos sociais, benefícios e estrutura de custo de pessoal no contexto da legislação trabalhista brasileira (CLT, eSocial, FGTS, INSS).

Ferramentas e Sistemas

  • Excel avançado — obrigatório: tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query, modelagem de cenários, funções complexas (PROCX, ÍNDICE/CORRESP, SE aninhado, matrizes dinâmicas).
  • Experiência com ERPs financeiros: SAP, Oracle, TOTVS ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis): Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, SAP BPC ou similares será considerado diferencial.
  • Noções de Power BI ou outras ferramentas de BI para construção de relatórios gerenciais.

Gestão de Pessoal e Workforce Planning

  • Experiência em controle de headcount (FTE, PJ, temporários, estagiários) e movimentações de pessoal.
  • Conhecimento de folha de pagamento e suas provisões contábeis.
  • Capacidade de modelar impactos financeiros de reajustes salariais, promoções, admissões e desligamentos.

Competências Comportamentais Diferenciadoras

  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto grau de organização para gestão de grandes volumes de dados orçamentários.
  • Capacidade de comunicação assertiva com stakeholders de diferentes níveis hierárquicos e áreas.
  • Mentalidade analítica e orientação a resultados.
  • Resiliência e capacidade de trabalho sob pressão, especialmente em períodos de fechamento orçamentário.


EXPERIÊNCIA DESEJADA

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em planejamento orçamentário, controladoria ou FP&A.
  • Experiência comprovada com custo de pessoal, folha de pagamento ou orçamento de RH.
  • Vivência em empresas de médio ou grande porte com processos orçamentários estruturados.

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. title: Clinical Research Associate - Biotech
description:
Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) – Oncology

São Paulo

Full-time | ✈️ Travel required

The Role

We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) with at least 1 year of on-site monitoring experience in oncology to support the successful delivery of clinical trials. In this role, you will be responsible for site monitoring, compliance, and data quality, playing a critical role in bringing innovative therapies to patients.

You will work closely with investigative sites and cross-functional project teams to ensure studies are conducted in accordance with GCP, ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and study protocols .

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits in line with the contracted scope of work
  • Ensure compliance with GCP, ICH, regulatory requirements, and study protocols
  • Partner with site staff to support and track patient recruitment and enrollment strategies
  • Deliver protocol and study-specific training to site personnel
  • Assess site performance, identify quality risks, and escalate issues proactively
  • Monitor study progress, including regulatory documentation, enrollment, CRF completion, and query resolution
  • Ensure accurate and complete maintenance of TMF and ISF documentation
  • Document monitoring activities through detailed visit reports, follow-ups, and correspondence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support overall study execution and timelines
  • Where applicable, support site-level recruitment planning and financial activities , including invoice tracking

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a health-related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 1 year of on-site monitoring experience , preferably in oncology
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Excellent communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required

Why apply?

  • Work on oncology-focused clinical trials with meaningful patient impact
  • Join a biotech-focused CRO environment known for agility and scientific alignment
  • Gain exposure to high-quality studies and collaborative project teams
  • Continue developing your CRA career within complex and innovative trials

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

Production Support Analyst

Job Description

The role involves close interaction with trading and business users, managing their requests, ensuring timely incident resolution, and providing deep functional and technical expertise. We are seeking a Fixed Income & Rates Technology Specialist with skills spanning Production Support,


QA Testing, and L2 Engineering. The role supports mission-critical platforms, including:

  • Fixed Income Trading Systems: Swaps, Bonds (Credit and Govies), Inflation-linked.
  • Portfolio Management Platforms (risk & pricing)
  • QA testing


The main responsibility is to provide production support during Latam trading hours. The successful candidates are expected to help with QA testing and L2 Engineering when not engaged with production support tasks.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Support

  • Support Fixed Income products: Bonds (Credit/Govies), Inflation-linked instruments, and Swaps.
  • Provide both functional and technical guidance to trading and business users, including incident ownership and resolution.
  • Participate in problem management to address recurring issues and drive long-term fixes.
  • Document incidents, requests, and solutions to enhance the knowledge database.

2. QA Testing & L2 Engineering

  • Perform functional, non-functional, and regression testing for Fixed Income trading platforms. Execute E2E, and integration tests.
  • Manage test cases and defects.
  • Identify, document, and track defects in Jira while collaborating with developers for resolution.
  • Assist throughout the application lifecycle, including project delivery and testing.
  • Depending on the candidate’s background: Implement minor enhancements and bug fixes. Develop monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively identify system issues.


Required Skills & Experience

Front Office trading systems experience preferred. Strong English; Spanish a plus.

1) Front Office Problem-Solving & Trader Support:

  • Rapid incident triage and business impact assessment during live trading
  • Root cause analysis across trade lifecycles (capture → booking → settlement)
  • Clear communication with traders under pressure; translating technical issues to business terms
  • Developing workarounds to maintain trading operations while issues are resolved

2) Financial Markets Domain Knowledge:

  • Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Credit, Govies, Inflation-linked instruments
  • eTrading and OTC workflows
  • Market data feeds
  • Pricing & risk analytics (PnL, sensitivities)

3) Testing & Validation:

  • Pre-market system and market data feed validation
  • Trade testing across Fixed Income products with P&L and risk sensitivity validation
  • Regression testing and UAT coordination with trading desks
  • Test case design based on real trading scenarios and edge cases


The ideal candidate would also know some of the following areas:

1) Incident & Test Management Tools:

  • Jira (ticket management, workflow tracking)
  • X-ray or similar test management tools (basic test case execution)

2) Technical Skills (familiarity with one or more):

  • Scripting: Basic SQL queries, simple Bash or PowerShell scripts for log analysis
  • Programming: Exposure to Python, Java, or JavaScript (able to read code and understand stack traces)
  • Log Analysis: Ability to parse application logs and identify error patterns. (Kibana or similar)

3) Infrastructure & Platform Awareness:

  • Basic understanding of cloud concepts (AWS services like Lambda, S3, EFS)
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and RESTful APIs
  • Understanding of message queuing systems (e.g., Kafka, MQ, SNS/SQS)
  • Database basics: ability to query relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DocumentDB)

4) Desirable but Not Required:

  • Experience with monitoring tools (Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana, Dynatrace)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to caching technologies (Redis, Memcached)

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities

  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities

Minimum Education:

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:

As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems.   • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.

  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.

  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.

  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. description:
Operador de Plataforma

  • Ambiente e clima de trabalho agradável e colaborativo

Título da Posição: Operador de Plataforma (iGaming)


Objetivo  

Atuar na linha de frente da operação diária, sendo o responsável direto pelo monitoramento em tempo real, integridade dos mercados e coordenação ágil de respostas a incidentes para garantir uma experiência de jogo ininterrupta.

  • Garantir o compliance (KYC, AML e Jogo Responsável) através de ferramentas de autoexclusão e limites.
  • Atuar como interface estratégica entre as equipes de Tech, Produto, Marketing e Financeiro.


Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia em operações de plataformas de apostas (iGaming) ou ambientes de alto volume.
  • Domínio de mercados esportivos e estrutura de apostas (Pré-jogo e Ao vivo).
  • Disponibilidade total para escala 24/7 (incluindo noites, finais de semana e feriados).
  • Excel/Google Sheets intermediário para análises operacionais.
  • Possuir todos os equipamentos necessários (computador, internet estável, etc.) para atuação 100% remota.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com plataformas B2B (Digitain, Betconstruct, Altenar, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em processos de pagamento (PIX) e regulamentação brasileira (Lei 14.790/2023).
  • Familiaridade com Jira e Inglês intermediário.


Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e alta capacidade de resolução de problemas sob pressão.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita para reporte e escalada de incidentes.


Etapas do Processo

  • Inscrição;
  • Triagem;
  • Entrevista RH;
  • Entrevista Gestor;
  • Offer;
  • Assinatura de Contrato.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Mandatory Skills Description:


  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.
  • Strong experience in Java, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, SQL or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.



Project Description:


  • Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.


Responsibilities:


  • We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.
  • You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).
  • Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.
  • Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.
  • Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.
  • Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

title: Consultor ERP - Módulo Produção
description:
Consultor ERP Sage X3 – Módulo Produção


Sobre a Empresa: A Axis é a Distribuidora Master do ERP Sage X3 para Brasil e América Latina. É uma empresa inovadora e em expansão, especializada em soluções tecnológicas para empresas de diversos segmentos. Buscamos profissionais comprometidos e altamente capacitados para se juntarem ao nosso time e contribuir com a implementação e otimização do sistema Sage X3.


Descrição da Vaga: Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência em consultoria funcional em algum dos principais ERPs do mercado ou no ERP Sage X3, com foco no módulo de Produção (Manufacturing) para discussão / levantamento / mapeamento de necessidades, para Implantação do ERP Sage X3 nos clientes. O profissional deve ter forte atuação em pré-venda, com habilidades para realizar discussão sobre o assunto e escopo, demonstrações técnicas e funcionais para potenciais clientes.

O(a) profissional atuará em projetos de implantação, melhorias e suporte evolutivo, além de participar diretamente do ciclo de pré-vendas consultivas, atuando junto ao time comercial para entender as necessidades do cliente, propor soluções e preparar / apresentar demonstrações práticas do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como consultor funcional no módulo de Produção do Sage X3, desde levantamento de requisitos até configuração e testes.
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos, mapeamento de processos e análise de necessidades do cliente, com foco no módulo de Produção do Sage X3.
  • Mapear processos produtivos e realizar parametrizações de chão de fábrica, ordens de produção, MRP, gestão de fórmulas, listas técnicas (BOM), roteiros e centros de trabalho.
  • Conduzir workshops com stakeholders e áreas usuárias para validação de escopo e aderência ao ERP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time comercial em processos de pré-venda: elaboração de propostas técnicas, resposta a RFPs/RFIs e participação em reuniões com prospects, participando das discussões e definição de escopo e estimativas.
  • Preparar e realizar demonstrações funcionais (demos) do ERP Sage X3 com foco no módulo de produção, destacando diferenciais da solução de forma prática.
  • Participar de sessões de prototipagem funcional com clientes.
  • Fazer / colaborar na elaboração de documentação funcional (BPs, especificações funcionais, manuais do usuário).
  • Implementar, configurar, parametrizar e personalizar o ERP Sage X3, focando na área de Distribuição.
  • Conduzir treinamentos e sessões de capacitação junto aos usuários finais e key-users.
  • Realizar integrações entre os módulos de Produção, Distribuição, e Financeiro/Contábil, garantindo a total sintonia entre os processos.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico contínuo para os usuários finais, solucionando dúvidas e desafios operacionais.
  • Treinar as equipes internas, dos parceiros e clientes no uso do sistema, buscando sempre melhorias nos processos produtivos.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas no fluxo de produção e propor soluções tecnológicas eficazes, identificando oportunidades de otimização e redução de custos.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos sistemas e propor novas funcionalidades ou customizações conforme as necessidades do cliente.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as equipes internas, parceiros e os clientes, sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para os desafios apresentados.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada, mínima de 3 anos (Pleno) e 5 anos (Sênior), com o ERP Sage X3 ou principais ERPs de mercado (SAP, Totus, Oracle), sendo foco em projetos no módulo de Produção (Manufacturing).
  • Conhecimento funcional sólido em:
  • Ordens de Produção
  • Listas Técnicas (BOM)
  • Roteiros de produção
  • MRP / Planejamento de necessidades
  • Gestão de chão de fábrica
  • Custos industriais
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação completa do ERP (end-to-end).
  • Experiência com os Módulos Financeiro/Contábil e Distribuição será altamente recomendada, e como eles são integrados ao Módulo de Produção do ERP.
  • Vivência em pré-vendas, com habilidade para preparar e conduzir demonstrações funcionais (presenciais e online).
  • Capacidade e experiência em realizar treinamentos, e apresentar soluções de forma clara e eficiente.
  • Capacidade de entender as necessidades dos clientes e propor soluções tecnológicas adequadas.
  • Facilidade em trabalhar com prazos e demandas simultâneas em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto escrita quanto verbal.
  • Experiência com documentação de processos e configuração do sistema.
  • Imprescindível domínio do idioma inglês (avançado/intermediário) para comunicação com clientes e fornecedores internacionais, e participação nos treinamentos / certificação SAGE.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e perfil colaborativo.


Desejável:

  • Certificação Sage X3.
  • Certificação em outros ERPs.
  • Experiência comprovada em outros ERPs.
  • Experiência em grandes projetos, em projetos internacionais ou em empresas multinacionais.
  • Conhecimentos em metodologias ágeis de implementação de ERP.
  • Formação Universitária em Engenharia de Produção.
  • Experiência em indústrias de manufatura discreta ou de processo.
  • Conhecimentos complementares em módulos Distribuição (Compras / Vendas / Estoque) e Financeiro.
  • Espanhol ou francês será considerado um plus.

Como se Candidatar: Se você atende aos requisitos e está pronto para um novo desafio, envie sua candidatura e carta de apresentação. Certifique-se de destacar sua experiência com o ERP Sage X3 e seu domínio do idioma inglês.

A Axis está aguardando o seu talento para fortalecer ainda mais nossa equipe e proporcionar grandes resultados para nossos clientes!

title: [Tech] Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
  • Praticar escuta ativa, acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
  • Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
  • Implementar práticas e ferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
  • Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade para atuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization


Details

  • Role Type: Full-time, Remote
  • Location: Open — at least partial overlap with PST preferred
  • Start Date: ASAP


How to Apply

Send us an email at with:

  • A few lines about what excites you about this role
  • Your resume
  • A link to your portfolio showcasing your best work


Email Only: Please note, we’re all about direct connections. Make sure to send your application via email.

title: Talent Data Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.


Key responsibilities:


- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.
